Deep learning based text processing uses algorithms to learn from datasets and extract patterns from text. This approach is typically rule-based, meaning that the rules are defined by a human expert and are used to guide the text processing operation.

Deep Learning Based Text Processing, on the other hand, uses artificial neural networks to analyze and process text. This approach is based on the idea of learning patterns in the data, rather than relying on predefined rules. Deep learning models are trained on large datasets and can learn to recognize complex patterns in the text, such as relationships between words and phrases. This approach is more flexible than rule-based text processing and can be used to perform a wide range of text processing tasks, such as language translation, sentiment analysis, and text summarization.
